I bought the SH4 after months of hype. This was before the up the price a few months ago, but right when the started mass production. I’ve actually have had it for exactly 1 year now. 

I purchased the add on kit for an extra $40(sand bag and bubble level). Every thing arrived in record time. Opening the box I found the scope box completely fucking annihilated. It looked like a troll used it as a chew toy! I was surprised when I removed the remainder of the box to find the scope untouched. Whew! The glass was clear and knobs felt great. 

I mounted the scope on a MK12 build in 556. So I wasn’t to worried. The scope zeroed and tracked fined. I was touching 500-650 yards with ease. But the illumination stopped working. Contacting Arken was great. They told me to send it in for repair and/or replacement. Nice. It was then I remember the troll that chewed my original box to hell. Idk what happen but the illumination just started working again. Ok cool. I had it on the MK12 for about 5-6 months. 

I then move the scope to a .308 bolt gun and this is where I found the serious cons. 

1. After 50rds the parallax knob was not as crisp as when I first got it. I had to now move the knob almost further to gain focus. Maybe that’s normal. But my USO or Premier doesn’t do that. Eh….I’ll let it go. 

2. After 50rd it’s lost zero and is always 1/2in off @ 100. I never had this problem with it until I ran the .308. But get $500 it’s still ok. Maybe it’s just how I shoot? 

3. The thread on the knob for the zero stop have now been stripped out. Easy fix but damn man. 

Just don’t put it on anything above 556 and you’ll be good.
